item.name: Additional Arms
entries: This secondary pair of arms installs beneath your normal arms. These arms are fully functional and can be used to hold weapons and {@item Shield|XPHB|Shields} (allowing you to wield two {@itemProperty 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed} weapons, or four onehanded weapons), perform Somatic components of spells, and perform other actions, though the arms themselves don't grant you any additional actions or body slots for grafts.

item.name: AI Core
entries: Your ship's {@item Arcane Terminal|DarkMatter24} has a sentient onboard artificial intelligence. This AI keeps the ship in running order and informs the crew of imminent danger.

The AI has an Intelligence of 17, a Wisdom of 13, and a Charisma of 14. It is proficient in the {@skill Data|DarkMatter24} and {@skill Technology|DarkMatter24} skills (with a +2 {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}).  The AI has a +3 modifier on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} that rely on Strength, Dexterity or Constitution. It can take the {@action Study|XPHB} action and will inform its passengers of any information it knows.
When needed, the AI can assume any Crew Role aboard the ship and perform any action provided by that role. The AI takes its turn at the end of the {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} order.
AI personalities can vary wildly. Some are snarky and pull pranks on their crew, while others are humorless and fiercely logical.

item.name: Android Skin
entries: Once installed, this mechanical skin and musculature makes you indistinguishable from a human. Your other grafts aren't visible while this graft is installed. Each Android Skin is modeled after an existing human, living or dead, and dozens of Android Skins exist.

item.name: Ankh of Ra
entries: This golden holy symbol, blessed by the Sun Above, shields you from death. If you drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} while you wear this ankh, roll {@dice 4d10}. Your {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} instead change to the number rolled. The ankh then loses its luster and becomes nonmagical.

entries.name: Magic Item Set
entries: Attuning to this ankh and a {@item Heretical Sunstaff of Ra|DarkMatter24} and {@item Solar Wings of Ra|DarkMatter24} counts as being attuned to a single item. If you are attuned to this ankh and one of these items, the ankh doesn't become nonmagical once used. Instead, it temporarily loses its luster and can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Arcane Cannon
entries: The Arcane Cannon magnifies a spellcaster's power, allowing them to cast Mega spells. This system is used by the Gunner with the Arcane Cannon action.

item.name: Arcane Resonator
entries: With this resonator installed in your body, you can synchronize with a magic item, allowing you to attune to up to four magic items at once.

item.name: Cantrip Module
entries: This module is loaded with a cantrip from the {@filter Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list|spells|source=|level=0|class=druid;wizard;cleric}. The spell is determined when the module is created. While it is installed, you learn this cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this cantrip when you cast it with this graft (choose each time you install this graft).

item.name: Arcane Terminal
entries: Arcane Terminals are essential units of computing in the 'Verse. Most information, from private financial records to a ship's Star Charts, are stored on such terminals. These terminals weigh 500 pounds and come equipped with a keyboard and monitor.

entries.name: Data Storage
entries: A terminal can store arbitrarily large amounts of data, including text, images, and video. Authorized users can search the terminal's data and the data of any other terminal connected to it as a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action. Typically, Arcane Terminals on populated worlds are connected together in planetary networks ("nets") which allow a user to comb through a vast, encyclopedic collection of knowledge, whereas individual terminals are more focused and may only contain information on a few topics.

entries.name: Communication Network
entries: If the terminal has an installed antenna, authorized users can interface with it using a {@item Datapad|DarkMatter24} out to a range of 1 mile. Multiple users can communicate with each other within that range, using text, audio, or video.

entries.name: Ship Computers and Other Functions.
entries: Starships generally have an Arcane Terminal aboard to control its sensors and systems. These terminals can also perform tasks such as opening and closing doors of a facility, issuing commands to Constructs, or processing technical data.

entries.name: Hacking
entries: Each terminal generally restricts access to authorized users. A DC 15 Intelligence ({@skill Data|DarkMatter24}) check can hack a terminal and provide unauthorized access. More secure systems might have higher DCs for this check. See the Glossary for rules on {@variantrule Hacking|DarkMatter24}.

item.name: Arcane Warhead
entries: This 4,000-pound bomb is capable of cataclysmic destruction.

entries.name: Arming the Warhead
entries: You can arm the warhead over the course of a minute if you know the warhead's command code and have a specially-made key attuned to it. Once the warhead is armed, you can set its method of detonation: Timed or Impact. If you choose a timed detonation, you enter a delay time of 1 minute, 10 minutes, or 1 hour, after which the warhead detonates. If you choose impact, the bomb lays dormant until it is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. The warhead has AC 18, 100 Hit Points (1 {@variantrule Mega Hit Points|DarkMatter24|Mega Hit Point}), and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage.

entries.name: Detonation
entries: When the warhead detonates, most things nearby are instantly vaporized. Within a 10-mile-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}, each creature and object takes {@dice 10d10 + 200} Mega Radiant damage. Each creature outside of the 10-mile-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} but within a 100-mile-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} makes a DC 20 Dexterity saving throw or take {@damage 10d10 + 50} Radiant damage, or half as much on a successful save. This damage ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB}. A creature that takes damage from this warhead has the {@condition Poisoned|XPHB} condition for 24 hours.
The epicenter of the blast becomes a spherical {@hazard Dead Magic Zone|DarkMatter24}, ranging from a few dozen feet to several miles in diameter.

item.name: Arm Blade
entries: This wide blade replaces an arm entirely. While this graft is installed, you can't be disarmed of it. This Arm Blade lacks any hand or manipulator, so you can't manipulate a weapon, {@item Shield|XPHB}, or other object with that hand while the blade is installed.

item.name: Arm Cannon
entries: This powerful blaster cannon replaces an arm entirely. While this graft is installed, you can't be disarmed of it. This Arm Cannon lacks any hand or manipulator, so you can't manipulate a weapon, {@item Shield|XPHB}, or other object with that hand while the cannon is installed.

item.name: Attractor Mine
entries: This small metallic disk hums with gravitational energy. When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing the mine to a space you can see within 30 feet of you. The mine firmly attaches to any surface it touches. If a creature other than you enters the 5-foot {@variantrule Cube [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cube} area originating at the top of the mine or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw or have its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} reduced to 0 until the start of its next turn. After 10 minutes, the mine burns out and becomes nonmagical.

item.name: B.E.G.
entries: The B.E.G.—short for "Big Effing Gun"—is an experimental weapon of unrivaled power. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can activate this weapon, creating an explosion of lightning and plasma in a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on a point you can see within 120 feet. Each creature in the area must succeed on a DC 18 Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 10d10 + 50} Radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
Once you use this item, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Ballistic Sledge
entries: Once on each of your turns, when you make a melee attack with this weapon, you can engage its thrusters to strike with extra force. You can lunge up to 15 feet toward your target before making the attack. Doing so doesn't spend movement or provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks}. On a hit, the attack deals an extra {@damage 1d4} Bludgeoning damage.

entries.name: Upgraded Magic Item
entries: This weapon grows in power as you do. When you reach character level 5, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. This bonus increases by +1 at level 11 (+2) and level 17 (+3).

item.name: Bandolier
entries: This shoulder strap contains six pouches large enough to hold a potion, grenade, or similarly-sized item within easy reach. It can hold 10 pounds of gear.

item.name: Binoculars
entries: Objects viewed through Binoculars are magnified to ten times their size.

item.name: Black Box
entries: Once installed, this device preserves your memories, allowing you to recall anything you have seen or heard while it is installed with perfect clarity. This device is incredibly resilient, and will remain intact despite otherwise catastrophic damage to your body. A Black Box's memories can be recovered with a DC 15 Intelligence ({@skill Technology|DarkMatter24}) check; a failure permanently corrupts the data. The data is also corrupted if it is installed in a new host.

These memories can be reviewed on a {@item Datapad|DarkMatter24}, {@item Arcane Terminal|DarkMatter24}, or similar computer. They can also be uploaded to a new body or a {@item Personality Module|DarkMatter24} using the {@spell Transfer Consciousness|DarkMatter24} spell.

item.name: Blaster Mod (+1 Enchanted Battery)
entries: This arcane battery surges with magical energy. While it is installed, you have a +1 bonus to ranged attack and damage rolls made with this blaster, which is a magic weapon. The bonus is determined by the battery's rarity and doesn't apply to magic weapons that already have a bonus to attack and damage rolls.

item.name: Blaster Mod (+2 Enchanted Battery)
entries: This arcane battery surges with magical energy. While it is installed, you have a +2 bonus to ranged attack and damage rolls made with this blaster, which is a magic weapon. The bonus is determined by the battery's rarity and doesn't apply to magic weapons that already have a bonus to attack and damage rolls.

item.name: Blaster Mod (+3 Enchanted Battery)
entries: This arcane battery surges with magical energy. While it is installed, you have a +3 bonus to ranged attack and damage rolls made with this blaster, which is a magic weapon. The bonus is determined by the battery's rarity and doesn't apply to magic weapons that already have a bonus to attack and damage rolls.

item.name: Blaster Mod (Aimbot)
entries: This elaborate mod contains an integrated Construct that can adjust your aim on the fly. This mod has 5 charges and regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} charges daily at dawn. When you make a ranged attack using this blaster, you can expend 1 charge for the Aimbot to attack on your behalf; you forgo rolling the {@dice d20} to get a 10 on the die. If the roll has {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} or {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, the 10 replaces only one of the two dice, and you roll the other {@dice d20} as normal.

item.name: Blaster Mod (Antimatter Battery)
entries: While this battery is installed, this blaster deals Necrotic damage instead of its normal damage type, and the target's {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the Necrotic damage it took. The creature dies if this effect reduces its {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point} maximum to 0.

item.name: Blaster Mod (Beam Module)
entries: When you make a ranged attack with this blaster, you can activate the Beam Module on the weapon's barrel to focus the shot into a 5-foot wide {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} that extends out to the weapon's normal range. Each creature in that {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes the weapon's normal damage plus an extra {@damage 2d6} Radiant damage, or half as much damage on a successful one. The blaster then Overheats; an overheated weapon can't be used again to make an attack until the end of your next turn. Once you use this mod, you can't use it again until the next dawn.

item.name: Blaster Mod (Dragonfire Break)
entries: While this barrel attachment is installed, this blaster deals Fire damage instead of its normal damage type and deals an extra {@damage 1d6} Fire damage to any target it hits.

item.name: Blaster Mod (Electrocoil)
entries: This barrel-mounted module emits sparks of lighting into the blaster's aperture. While it is installed, this blaster deals Lightning damage instead of its normal damage type and it gains the {@itemMastery Jolt|ValdaSpire24} mastery property in addition to its normal mastery property. You can only use one mastery property on each attack. You can use the {@itemMastery Jolt|ValdaSpire24} property of the blaster, even if you don't have the Weapon Mastery feature, and it doesn't count against the number of weapons you can use.

item.name: Blaster Mod (Extended Barrel)
entries: The normal and long ranges of the blaster double.

item.name: Blaster Mod (Magnetic Mount)
entries: The quantum electromagnet installed on the blaster allows you to use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to pull the blaster to your open hand if it is within 60 feet of you and isn't being carried. You can't be disarmed of the blaster unless you have the {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} condition.

item.name: Blaster Mod (Overcharge Module)
entries: This external arcane battery overloads your blaster with a surge of energy. When you make a ranged attack with this blaster, you can choose to make an overcharged shot. Doing so causes the blaster to deal an extra {@damage 6d6} damage to the target on a hit. The blaster then Overheats; an overheated weapon can't be used again to make an attack until the end of your next turn. Once you use this mod, you can't use it again until the next dawn.

item.name: Blaster Mod (Reinforced Frame)
entries: This composite alloy chassis reinforces the blaster against impacts and enables it to be used as a blunt implement. The weapon gains the {@itemMastery Bludgeon|ValdaSpire24Extras} mastery property in addition to its normal mastery property, though you can only use one mastery property on each attack. You can use the {@itemMastery Bludgeon|ValdaSpire24Extras} mastery property of the blaster, even if you don't have the Weapon Mastery feature, and it doesn't count against the number of weapons you can use.

item.name: Blaster Mod (Ricochet Barrel)
entries: Your Ranged weapon attacks using blasters ignore {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Half Cover} and {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Three-Quarters Cover}, if there exists a solid surface off of which to ricochet the shot towards the target. You can target a creature in {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} with a ricocheted ranged attack using this blaster with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}. As normal, if you're guessing the location of a creature in {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} and the creature isn't in the space you targeted, you miss.

item.name: Blaster Mod (Scope)
entries: This high-magnification scope improves the blaster's accuracy, at the cost of close quarters functionality. You don't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ranged attacks using this weapon at long range. However, while this mod is installed, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ranged attacks using this weapon out to its normal range.

item.name: Blaster Mod (Silencer)
entries: The hefty suppressor installed on this blaster causes attacks made with it to make only a low pew audible out to 10 feet. The light given off by the blaster is also masked, resulting in a flash at its point of impact, but no visible streak through the air.

item.name: Blaster Mod (Thermal Sights)
entries: This non-magnifying scope grants you {@sense Thermalsight|DarkMatter24} out to the blaster's normal range while you are making attacks using this blaster. Your {@sense Thermalsight|DarkMatter24} provided by this mod is limited to a narrow tunnel. As a result, you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks that rely on this {@sense Thermalsight|DarkMatter24}.

item.name: Blaster Prototype
entries: Every blaster in the 'Verse, from pocket-sized Phasers to ship-mounted Pulse Cannons, operate on the same basic principle: focusing the energy from an arcane battery through an aperture to create an burst of radiation. However, the progenitor to all blasters predates the invention of arcane batteries, and instead utilized a more potent power source: a mortal soul.

The Blaster Prototype was the magnum opus of legendary dwarven inventor Metzer Glimwrought. As the device neared its completion, Metzer's daughter, Vantha Glimwrought, suddenly took ill and deteriorated quickly. Doctors could furnish no cure and Metzer, desperate, turned to necromancy. Using the ritual that binds a lich's phylactery, Metzer bound his daughter's soul to the prototype, simultaneously forestalling her death and furnishing the blaster with an immense power source.

entries.name: Magic Weapon
entries: The Blaster Prototype is a magic weapon that grants a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with it.

entries.name: Auto-Aim
entries: If you roll less than 10 on the {@dice d20} for an attack roll with the Blaster Prototype, you can replace the roll with a 10. The prototype can choose not to grant this benefit, or to instead replace the roll with a 1 if it believes a target is unsuitable.

entries.name: Blaster Mastery
entries: You can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to change the blaster's mastery property to that of any blaster of your choice. You can use the mastery property of the blaster, even if you don't have the Weapon Mastery feature, and it doesn't count against the number of weapons you can use. Once you change the mastery property, you can't do so again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Machine Code
entries: Using its {@language Machine Code|DarkMatter24} language, the Blaster Prototype can cast the {@spell Technomancy|DarkMatter24} cantrip.

entries.name: Sentience
entries: The Blaster Prototype is a sentient Chaotic Neutral weapon with an Intelligence of 16, a Wisdom of 10, and a Charisma of 15. It has hearing and {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} out to 120 feet.

The prototype speaks {@language Common|XPHB}, {@language Dwarvish|XPHB}, and {@language Machine Code|DarkMatter24}, the native code-language of machines, and it can communicate with its wielder telepathically.

entries.name: Personality
entries: Though the prototype is ageless, its personality belongs to a young woman, Vantha Glimwrought, and speaks in an upbeat, chipper tone. The Prototype urges its user to travel to new places and meet interesting people; likewise, it hates being holstered, hidden away, or ignored. Even in life, Vantha was shut away and built up an insatiable wanderlust.

Vantha has complex feelings about her father, the prototype's inventor. Without question, she's grateful to be alive, but feels like her present, captive circumstances are somehow an extension of her father's overbearing nature, even after his death.
Vantha has reservations about being used on Humanoids and will never fire on a person she deems innocent.

entries.name: Destroying the Blaster
entries: The Blaster Prototype is protected by all manner of enchantments from one of history's most ingenious arcanists, rendering it impervious to damage. However, if the blaster is connected to a sufficiently large power source, like a Class 7 or 8 Dark Matter engine at the moment of a void jump, the power surge would be enough to overload the blaster and destroy it.

item.name: Bottled Lightning
entries: A bolt of magic lightning surges around inside this glass canister, casting {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 10-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 10 feet.

When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action on your turn, you can replace one of your attacks with throwing the Bottled Lightning. Target one creature or object you can see within 20 feet of yourself. The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Dexterity modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) or take {@damage 2d8} Lightning damage and be unable to make {@action Opportunity Attack|XPHB|Opportunity Attacks} until the start of its next turn.

item.name: Bounty Hunter's Carbine
entries: You gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

entries.name: Tracker
entries: When you hit a creature with an attack using the carbine, you can mark the target for 24 hours. While the creature is marked and it and the blaster are on the same plane of existence, the blaster beeps intermittently to indicate the target's distance to you. This mark ends if the creature dies or you mark a different creature.

entries.name: Nonlethal
entries: When you reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} using this weapon, you can instead knock the target out, as you would with a Melee weapon.

entries.name: Magic Item Set
entries: If you are carrying this carbine and wearing a {@item Bounty Hunter's Vest|DarkMatter24}, you can disarm your target with a well-placed shot. When you hit a creature with an attack using the carbine and exceed the target's AC by 5 or more or score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|XPHB}, the target makes a DC 15 Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it drops an object of your choice that it's holding, which lands at its feet.

item.name: Bounty Hunter's Vest
entries: The holsters on this vest lead to an extradimensional space capable of perfectly concealing two blasters and a Melee weapon. A weapon stored in the extradimensional space can be drawn at a moment's notice, even outside of your turn, without using a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB}.

entries.name: Magic Item Set
entries: If you are wearing this vest and carrying a {@item Bounty Hunter's Carbine|DarkMatter24}, you can treat the result of your {@variantrule Initiative|XPHB} rolls as 10, or your character level plus your Dexterity modifier, whichever is higher.

item.name: Brass Repeater
entries: When you hit a target with this weapon and roll the same number on two or more different damage dice, you can add your Dexterity modifier to the damage roll.

entries.name: Upgraded Magic Item
entries: This weapon grows in power as you do. When you reach character level 5, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. This bonus increases by +1 at level 11 (+2) and level 17 (+3).

item.name: Captain's Chair
entries: The ship gains the Captain Crew Role.

item.name: Climbing Apparatus
entries: You have installed a device that allows you to cling to surfaces and move with agility on walls and ceilings. You gain a {@variantrule Climb Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.
Your Climbing Apparatus might resemble a set of peripheral limbs, magnetic attractors, or a grapple-hook-launching mechanism.

item.name: Cloaking
entries: The Cloaking system has 6 charges and regains {@dice 1d6} expended charges daily at dawn. The Engineer can take the Use System action to expend 1 charge and give the ship the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. This condition ends immediately after the ship attacks, deals damage, or moves more than 1,000 feet on its turn.

item.name: Clockwork Wings
entries: Folded into your back when not in use, these silver, mechanical wings grant you a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}. You can deploy or retract these wings as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Additionally, you can deploy the wings as a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} while you are falling.

item.name: Comm Set
entries: Using this handheld device, you can verbally communicate with any creature within 1 mile that also has a Comm Set. A Comm Set can be connected to a headset worn on the ear or can be talked into directly. Its signal can penetrate most barriers, but is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of common metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

item.name: Concentration Module
entries: Your body houses a secondary mechanical mind  to assist in arcane focus. Whenever you make a Constitution saving throw to maintain {@status Concentration|XPHB} on a spell, you can add your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (your choice when you install this graft), to the roll instead of your Constitution modifier.

item.name: Concussion Grenade
entries: This spherical device, dotted with blinking lights, explodes in a wave of concussive force. You can take the {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to throw this grenade up to 30 feet. At the start of your next turn, the grenade detonates in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}. The grenade has AC 13 and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB} to Poison and Psychic damage; it detonates immediately if it takes damage after it is thrown. Each creature within the area makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 6d6} Thunder damage and has the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and doesn't have the {@condition Deafened|XPHB} condition.

entries.name: Chain Reaction
entries: If one or more Concussion Grenades that aren't being worn or carried are within the blast radius of a Concussion Grenade when it detonates, all of the grenades detonate simultaneously in a chain reaction. The Thunder damage increases by {@dice 1d6} and the blast radius increases by 5 feet for each grenade, up to a maximum of {@dice 10d6} and a 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere}.

item.name: Contractor Nail
entries: If you roll a 6 on a {@dice d6} for this weapon's damage roll, you can roll another {@dice d6}, and add it to the damage. When you roll damage with this weapon, you can add a maximum of four d6s to the weapon's damage roll.

entries.name: Magic Item Set
entries: Once on each of your turns, if you hit a target with this weapon and the target has already been hit with an attack using a {@item Contractor Needle|DarkMatter24} this turn, you can deal an extra {@damage 2d6} Radiant damage to the target.

item.name: Contractor Needle
entries: If you roll a 4 on a {@dice d4} for this weapon's damage roll, you can roll another {@dice d4}, and add it to the damage. When you roll damage with this weapon, you can add a maximum of four d4s to the weapon's damage roll.

entries.name: Magic Item Set
entries: Once on each of your turns, if you hit a target with this weapon and the target has already been hit with an attack using a {@item Contractor Nail|DarkMatter24} this turn, you can make one additional attack against the target using this weapon.

item.name: Cryogenic Pod
entries: This capsule, large enough to fit one Medium or smaller creature, can provide air and heat for its occupant indefinitely. A creature inside the pod can set a duration ranging from one month to 1,000 years and activate the pod as a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action. The pod then locks and cryogenically freezes the creature and the rest of the pod's contents over the course of a minute. A frozen creature has the {@condition Unconscious|XPHB} condition, doesn't age, and doesn't need air, food, or water. When the duration expires, the pod deactivates, thawing the creature and the pod's contents over the course of a minute. The pod then unlocks.
If a creature fails to set a duration on the pod, it remains frozen until another creature takes a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to deactivate and unlock the pod.

item.name: Data Drive
entries: This 1-inch long drive can store arbitrarily large amounts of data, including text, images, and video. Over the course of a minute, you can transfer information between a Data Drive and an {@item Arcane Terminal|DarkMatter24}, {@item Datapad|DarkMatter24}, or similar computer. You can only upload or download information you have access to; certain information may be encrypted and be accessible only to authorized users. Information stored on a Data Drive can't be directly read without a device like a {@item Datapad|DarkMatter24} that has an interface.

item.name: Datapad
entries: This flat, rectangular device can perform countless personal computing tasks. For example, a Datapad can take text notes, view downloaded data, transfer credits to and from the Galactic Bank, and interface with other devices.

Datapads can interface with one another and {@item Arcane Terminal|Darkmatter24|Arcane Terminals} within a range of 1 mile. Users can communicate with each other using text, audio, or video, and search the contents of any connected {@item Arcane Terminal|DarkMatter24}. Typically, {@item Arcane Terminal|Darkmatter24|Arcane Terminals} on populated worlds are connected together in planetary networks ("nets") which allow a user to comb through a vast, encyclopedic collection of knowledge and provide connection between any two users across the planet.

item.name: Death Ray
entries: You have a +3 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While attuned to it, you can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to cast the {@spell Disintegrate|XPHB} spell (DC 17) using it. The blaster can't be used in this way again until the next dawn.

item.name: Deck of Holding
entries: The deck is a handheld device with a large screen that is connected to an extradimensional space. As a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, you can touch an object that isn't being worn or carried by another creature to the deck, teleporting it to the extradimensional space. The object must be less than 4 feet across in every dimension and weigh less than 150 pounds. The Deck of Holding can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. Its inventory can be viewed on its screen. As a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action while holding the deck, you can select any item stored within and teleport it to your hands or to an unoccupied space on the ground within 5 feet of you.
If the Deck of Holding is destroyed, its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane.

Placing the deck in an extradimensional space (such as one created by a {@item Bag of Holding|XDMG}) instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on the gate is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way only and can't be reopened.

item.name: Deck of Holding (Expanded Storage)
entries: The deck is a handheld device with a large screen that is connected to an extradimensional space. As a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, you can touch an object that isn't being worn or carried by another creature to the deck, teleporting it to the extradimensional space. The object must be less than 4 feet across in every dimension and weigh less than 150 pounds. The Deck of Holding can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. Its inventory can be viewed on its screen. As a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action while holding the deck, you can select any item stored within and teleport it to your hands or to an unoccupied space on the ground within 5 feet of you.
If the Deck of Holding is destroyed, its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane.

Placing the deck in an extradimensional space (such as one created by a {@item Bag of Holding|XDMG}) instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on the gate is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way only and can't be reopened.

entries.name: Expanded Storage (Rare)
entries: The Deck of Holding can hold up to 2,000 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 256 cubic feet.

item.name: Deck of Holding (Password Protected)
entries: The deck is a handheld device with a large screen that is connected to an extradimensional space. As a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, you can touch an object that isn't being worn or carried by another creature to the deck, teleporting it to the extradimensional space. The object must be less than 4 feet across in every dimension and weigh less than 150 pounds. The Deck of Holding can hold up to 500 pounds, not exceeding a volume of 64 cubic feet. Its inventory can be viewed on its screen. As a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action while holding the deck, you can select any item stored within and teleport it to your hands or to an unoccupied space on the ground within 5 feet of you.
If the Deck of Holding is destroyed, its contents are scattered in the Astral Plane.

Placing the deck in an extradimensional space (such as one created by a {@item Bag of Holding|XDMG}) instantly destroys both items and opens a gate to the Astral Plane. The gate originates where one item was placed inside the other. Any creature within 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on the gate is sucked through it to a random location on the Astral Plane. The gate then closes. The gate is one-way only and can't be reopened.

entries.name: Password Protected Deck (Rare)
entries: The deck is locked with a password associated with its user. Only someone with the password can store or retrieve items from the space. However, a DC 18 Intelligence ({@skill Data|DarkMatter24}) check can hack the device and provide unauthorized access.

item.name: Diode Beam
entries: This two-handed beam weapon has 3 charges and regains all expended charges daily at dawn. When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can expend 1 charge to replace one of your attacks with a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} in a direction you choose. Each creature in the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 3d8} Radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Upgraded Magic Item
entries: If you have proficiency in Martial weapons, this item grows in power as you do. The item's save DC increases when you reach level 5 (DC 15), 11 (DC 17), and 17 (DC 18).

item.name: Dome Projector
entries: Activating this egg-shaped device as an action creates a dome of force centered on the projector as if you had cast the {@spell Geodesic Shield|DarkMatter24} spell. When the spell ends, the projector burns out and becomes nonmagical.

item.name: Double Laser Sword
entries: The long hilt of this laser sword projects a second blade from its far end. You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls with this magic weapon. Instead of {@itemProperty V|XPHB|Versatile}, this weapon has the {@itemProperty 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed}. Immediately after you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action and attack with this weapon, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to make a second melee attack with the weapon.

item.name: Drive Wheel
entries: By grasping the two handles on this foot-wide steering wheel, you can cast the {@spell Speedcycle|DarkMatter24} spell. The motorcycle materializes beneath you and attaches to the steering wheel.
Once you use this item to cast the {@spell Speedcycle|DarkMatter24} spell, it can't be used again until the following dawn.

item.name: Drone Controller
entries: This set of controls, either installed in a glove, integrated onto a {@item Datapad|DarkMatter24}, or linked into a visor, allows you to control a drone. Each controller is linked to a drone, using the {@creature Personal Drone|DarkMatter24} stat block, and is either an Assault drone, a Medical drone, or a Shield drone.

entries.name: Drone Combat
entries: While attuned to the controller, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to issue commands to the drone. Your drone takes its turn immediately before or after your turn each round (your choice). If you issue no commands, the drone doesn't take any actions. Once given an order, the drone continues to follow it until its task is complete.

item.name: Embedded Armor
entries: Your base {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} equals 13 plus your Dexterity modifier. You can wear armor on top of your Embedded Armor, and you can use either armor to determine your AC. You can use a {@item Shield|XPHB} and still gain this benefit.

item.name: Embedded Mini Fridge
entries: This convenient insulated box in your abdomen can store and chill up to six cans of {@item Krash|DarkMatter24}, potions, or similar beverages.

item.name: Embedded Translator
entries: You have a {@item Universal Translator|DarkMatter24} magic item installed within your skull and can use it at will.

item.name: Embedded Weapon
entries: This Simple or Martial weapon is embedded directly into one or both of your arms. When you draw this weapon, your hand or hands transform into that weapon and you can't be disarmed of it. You can't hold or otherwise manipulate a weapon, {@item Shield|XPHB}, or other object with a hand that is transformed.

item.name: Encyclopedia Multiplanaria
entries: This {@item Datapad|DarkMatter24} is enchanted to hold an incredible wealth of information. However, the data isn't indexed, so the Encyclopedia only provides data that it believes will be useful at any given moment. The Encyclopedia 3 charges, and regains all charges daily at dawn. When you take the {@action Study|XPHB} action, you can expend 1 charge to access the Encyclopedia and gain a +20 to any Intelligence checks you make as a part of that action.

item.name: Engineer's Pack
entries: An Engineer's Pack includes a {@item Backpack|XPHB}, a {@item Comm Set|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Crowbar|XPHB}, a {@item Datapad|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Flashlight|DarkMatter24}, a Hammer, an {@item Igniter|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Life Suit|DarkMatter24}, dozens of assorted nuts and bolts, an {@item Omnitool|DarkMatter24}, 10 rolls of {@item Vent Tape|DarkMatter24}, and a {@item Wristwatch|DarkMatter24}.

item.name: Engineer's Station
entries: The ship gains the Engineer role.

item.name: Escape Pods
entries: This ship contains a bay with sufficient Escape Pods for each crew member and passenger. A creature can take the {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to board an Escape Pod and eject from the ship. On a Fighter, the Pilot ejects automatically when the ship drops to 0 {@variantrule Mega Hit Points|DarkMatter24}.

The pod travels far enough to clear any explosion of the ship and then drifts aimlessly. The pod has minimal thrusters—enough to change direction two or three times—and enough air, power, and rations to sustain a passenger for 7 days. Each Escape Pod automatically produces a distress signal that can be detected by any ship with Sensors, though such a signal only travels at the speed of light. An Escape Pod and its passenger can survive reentry on most planets.

item.name: Etheradio
entries: An essential tool for galactic communication, an Etheradio transmits and receives its messages though the Ethereal Plane. This device stands over 6 feet tall (with an antenna that extends its length by an additional 3 feet) and weighs 1,000 pounds.

entries.name: Transmitting
entries: An operator can use the device as a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to transmit an audio message of up to 10 minutes to a specific Etheradio on the same plane of existence or to an etheradio station. Hundreds of stations exist, many of them earmarked for specific uses, such as streaming music or government communications. By broadcasting on an emergency station, an Etheradio can transmit a message to all other Etheradios on the same plane of existence, but it can only send such a message once per day. No matter the distance, messages take 10 minutes to reach their destination.

entries.name: Receiving
entries: The Etheradio stores the most recent 10 hours of audio it has directly received. An operator can use the device as a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to listen to stored audio or to tune into an Etheradio station.

entries.name: Calibration
entries: An Etheradio only works if it is calibrated according to its location in the universe. Calibrating this device takes 1 hour, and it must be recalibrated if it is ever moved more than 100 miles. Calibration takes into account regular cosmic motion, such as a planet's orbit.

item.name: Exo-Frame
entries: The enormous frame, which weighs in excess of 2,000 pounds, seems less like a suit of armor and more like a mechanized, bipedal vehicle. You don't need armor training to wear this armor. You can don and doff it as a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action by traveling through a series of hatches on the front of the suit. You gain the following benefits while wearing the armor.

entries.name: Armor Class
entries: While wearing this armor, your {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} equals 18 (your Dexterity modifier doesn't affect this number). You can use a {@item Shield|XPHB} and still gain this benefit.

entries.name: Size
entries: Your size becomes Large, if it was smaller.

entries.name: Mighty
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and saving throws.

entries.name: Integrated Battlefists
entries: The frame has two integrated {@item Battlefist|DarkMatter24|Battlefists}. While wearing the armor, you have proficiency with these weapons.

entries.name: Life Suit
entries: The frame confers the benefits of a {@item Life Suit|DarkMatter24}.

item.name: Fighter Bay
entries: The ship gains the ability to dock a Fighter-size ship within it. A creature can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to board the Fighter and eject it from the ship, entering the Pilot role in that ship. A Fighter can dock into a Fighter Bay as an action.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can install this system more than once into a ship, depending on the ship's size: Transport (2 bays), Corvette (3 bays), Frigate (3 bays), Cruiser (4 bays), and Capital (4 bays).

item.name: Final Word
entries: Deep within your body, you have installed a miniature {@item Arcane Warhead|DarkMatter24}, whose trigger is linked to your life. When you die, this bomb detonates and destroys your body completely; as a result, you can be restored to life only by means of a {@spell True Resurrection|XPHB} or {@spell Wish|XPHB} spell. Each creature within a 180-foot radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} centered on your body makes a DC 19 Dexterity saving throw. Creatures within a 60-foot radius that have Evasion or a similar feature can't avoid this damage. On a failed save, a creature takes {@dice 1d4} Mega ({@dice 1d4 × 100}) Force damage, or half as much on a successful save.

item.name: Finger Gun Glove
entries: While wearing this fingerless glove, you can cast the {@spell Finger Guns|ValdaGunslinger} cantrip using your spellcasting ability. You can use the mastery property of the Finger Guns while attuned to this item.

item.name: Finger Picks
entries: Your mechanical hand has a retractable set of {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB} built directly into the fingers. You can extend or retract these tools as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. While retracted, you can conceal them perfectly. You have proficiency with {@item Thieves' Tools|XPHB} while the picks are installed. If you already have proficiency, your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} is doubled for any ability check you make that uses them.

item.name: Flamethrower
entries: This two-handed nozzle, connected to a backpack of arcane batteries, has 7 charges and regains {@dice 1d6 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn.

When you take the {@action Attack|XPHB} action, you can replace one or more of your attacks with a 15-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} of fire from the Flamethrower, expending 1 charge for each attack replaced in this way. Each creature in that area makes a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw, taking {@damage 3d6} Fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Upgraded Magic Item
entries: If you have proficiency in Martial weapons, this item grows in power as you do. The item's save DC increases when you reach level 5 (DC 15), 11 (DC 17), and 17 (DC 18).

item.name: Flare
entries: A Flare is a foot-long, brightly colored stick with a plastic cap. You can strike the bottom of the Flare as a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, causing it to burst into a bright, colored flame, matching that of the stick. This flame burns for 10 minutes, emitting a 40-foot radius of {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 20 feet. A Flare can burn underwater and in a vacuum.

item.name: Flashback Polaroid
entries: This antique camera is loaded with a roll of film containing {@dice 1d6 + 2} blank photos. You can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to take a picture using the camera, casting the {@spell Flashback|DarkMatter24} spell. The developed photo depicts the events that the spell has altered. When all of the camera's photos have been taken, it ceases to be magical.

item.name: Flashbang
entries: As a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, you can throw this spherical device up to 30 feet, which detonates in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} a moment after impact. Each creature within the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw or have the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} and {@condition Deafened|XPHB} conditions until the start of your next turn. A creature that shields its eyes and ears automatically succeeds on this saving throw.

item.name: Flashlight
entries: A Flashlight produces a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone} of {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}, and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 15 feet. It can provide light for up to 4 hours, after which it must recharge for 8 hours.

item.name: Freeze Bomb
entries: As a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, you can throw this bomb up to 30 feet, where it detonates in a 10-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} a moment after impact. Each creature within the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} must succeed on a DC 13 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 3d8} Cold damage and its {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0 and it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage only.

item.name: Gamestation
entries: This scaled-down {@item Datapad|DarkMatter24} is packed with dozens of digital amusements and diversions that test a user's reflexes and puzzle-solving skills. If you spend a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB} playing on this Gamestation, you gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the next ability check you make before you finish a {@variantrule Short Rest|XPHB|Short} or {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

item.name: Gaming Set (Digital Games)
entries: Digital games are a variant of {@item Gaming Sets|XPHB} that can be played on any {@item Arcane Terminal|DarkMatter24}, {@item Datapad|DarkMatter24}, or {@item Gamestation|DarkMatter24}. These games range from arcade-like to immersively realistic.

item.name: Gamma Fragment
entries: This crystalline fragment of pure hardlight has 6 charges and regains {@dice 1d6} expended charges daily at dawn. Whenever you make a {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB}, you can expend a number of charges up to your proficiency bonus and add that number to the number rolled on the {@dice d20}, to a maximum of 20. If you use the fragment to improve an attack roll that deals damage, you can change the damage type to Force.

entries.name: Magic Item Set
entries: Attuning to multiple Gamma Fragments counts as being attuned to a single item. Add the charges into a single pool that regains {@dice 1d6} expended charges for each fragment daily at dawn.

item.name: Gamma Pendant
entries: Like many techno-magical marvels, hardlight magic was uncovered through experimentation and happenstance. However, this was not the first time hardlight had been discovered, as evidenced by the Gamma Pendant.

The pendant is a gleaming mithral medallion, set with fragments of a glowing green crystal. In ages past, the pendant was destroyed and its {@item Gamma Fragment|DarkMatter24|Gamma Fragments} scattered across the 'Verse. Each of these fragments is a magic item in its own right, sought and coveted by an order of Paladins known as Gamma Knights, but the pendant itself is a thing of unparalleled power.

entries.name: Incomplete Pendant
entries: Even while missing fragments, the pendant has the following properties.

entries.name: Flight
entries: You have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

entries.name: Starborn
entries: You can breathe underwater or in the vacuum of space and you are unaffected by extreme temperatures and pressures (see the Glossary).

entries.name: Lesser Spellcasting
entries: The pendant has 10 charges and regains {@dice 1d6 + 4} expended charges daily at dawn. You can cast any of the Lesser Spells on the Hardlight Spells table from the pendant (save DC 18). The table indicates how many charges you must expend to cast the spell.

entries.name: Completing the Pendant
entries: If three or more {@item Gamma Fragment|DarkMatter24|Gamma Fragments} are unified with the Gamma Pendant, the pendant becomes whole and gains the following additional properties.

entries.name: Gamma Fragments
entries: The pendant gains the benefits of all unified {@item Gamma Fragment|DarkMatter24|Gamma Fragments}.

entries.name: Greater Spellcasting
entries: The pendant's spellcasting improves. It has 20 changes and regains {@dice 1d10 + 10} expended charges daily at dawn. You can cast any of the spells on the Hardlight Spells table from the pendant (save DC 18).

entries.name: Hardlight Edge
entries: Any weapon you wield has a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls and can deal Force damage or the weapon's normal damage type (your choice). If the weapon already has a bonus to attack and damage rolls, use the larger bonus.

entries.name: Spell Absorption
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make against spells. Additionally, in response to a creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself casting a spell, you can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to absorb that spell. The spell dissipates with no effect, the action, {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, or {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} used to cast it is wasted, and the pendant regains a number of charges equal to the absorbed spell's level, up to a maximum of 20 charges. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Destroying the Pendant
entries: The Gamma Pendant is impervious to damage. However, it can be shattered by smashing it between two sufficiently large hardlight constructs: each would need to be roughly the size of a small planet to achieve the desired effect.

item.name: Golem Arms
entries: These limbs originate with a golem or similar Construct. Once installed, your reach is 5 feet greater whenever you make an attack with a Melee weapon or {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Strength checks and saving throws.

item.name: Grasshopper
entries: This magic weapon deals an extra {@damage 2d10} Radiant damage on a hit and the target is pushed 10 feet away from you. Once you make an attack with this weapon, it {@itemMastery Overheat|DarkMatter24|Overheats}. An overheated weapon can't be used to make an attack until the end of your next turn.

item.name: Gravity Gun
entries: This device has 7 charges and regains {@dice 1d6 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to expend 1 charge and cast {@spell Levitate|XPHB} (DC 13) from it. Instead of the target rising vertically up to 20 feet, it is pulled directly toward the device, levitating in a space of your choice within 5 feet of you.

You can take a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to violently repel a levitating target within 5 feet of yourself. In a Zero-Gravity environment, all creatures and objects are considered to be levitating. The target is pushed up to 60 away from you in a direction that you choose, ending the {@spell Levitate|XPHB} spell. If the target contact hits an obstacle, both the target and the obstacle take {@damage 4d6} damage. The GM decides if this damage is Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing.

entries.name: Upgraded Magic Item
entries: If you have proficiency in Martial weapons, this item grows in power as you do. The item's save DC increases when you reach character level 5 (DC 15), 11 (DC 17), and 17 (DC 18).

item.name: Gravity Nullifier
entries: You can attach this fist-sized device to an object weighing less than 2,000 pounds as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, nullifying the object's mass as if it were targeted by the {@spell Levitate|XPHB} spell. The nullifier functions for 10 minutes, after which it burns out and permanently ceases to function. If the object is still aloft, it gently floats to the ground.

item.name: Greater Shipmending Spray
entries: This canister of pressurized nanites rapidly repairs damage to ships. The canister weighs 20 pounds and can be used as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action from within or outside a damaged ship. The ship regains {@dice 6d6} {@variantrule Mega Hit Points|DarkMatter24}.

item.name: Gunner Bay
entries: The ship gains the Gunner role.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can install this system more than once into a ship.

item.name: Hacker Hands
entries: Your newly-installed fingers can plug directly into machines and subdivide into smaller digits for faster typing. While installed, this graft counts as having an {@item Interface Rig|DarkMatter24}.

When you fail an attempt to hack a device, you can use this graft to reroll it, potentially turning failure into success. You must use the new roll, and you can't use this graft to reroll again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

item.name: Hardlight Bracer
entries: This magic bracer has 20 charges. You can expend 1 charge as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to produce a {@item Hardlight Dart|DarkMatter24} to your open hand. If unused, this dart evaporates into light after 24 hours. The bracer regains {@dice 1d10 + 5} charges daily at dawn.

item.name: Heart of Steel
entries: You have replaced your heart with an automaton's construct core. You don't need to sleep, and magic can't put you to sleep. You can finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB} in 4 hours if you spend those hours in a motionless state, during which you retain consciousness.

item.name: Heavy Legs
entries: You have installed a mechanical exoskeleton, rooted in your legs. You can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to kick a creature of Large size or smaller within 5 feet of you. Make an {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}. On a hit, the target is pushed 5 feet away from you.
You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

item.name: Heretical Sunstaff of Ra
entries: This sunstaff was once carried by a heretical avia-ra apologist. When the staff deals the Bludgeoning damage of its {@itemMastery Bludgeon|ValdaSpire24Extras} mastery property, it deals an extra {@damage 1d6} Radiant damage.

entries.name: Upgraded Magic Item
entries: This weapon grows in power as you do. When you reach character level 5, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. This bonus increases by +1 at level 11 (+2) and level 17 (+3).

entries.name: Magic Item Set
entries: Attuning to this sunstaff and an {@item Ankh of Ra|DarkMatter24} and {@item Solar Wings of Ra|DarkMatter24} counts as being attuned to a single item. If you are attuned to the sunstaff and one of these items, you can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to unleash a blinding beam of light in a 5-foot-wide, 60-foot-long {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}. Each creature in the {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line} must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or be {@condition Blinded|XPHB} until the end of your next turn. The staff can't be used in this way again until the next dawn.

item.name: Holo-Companion
entries: When the button set into the top of this small, faceted orb is pressed as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, holo-emitters generate a translucent humanoid figure, which the orb floats inside. This figure functions identically to the {@spell Unseen Servant|XPHB} spell, though it is visible (with an appearance determined by the creator).

item.name: Holo-Sphere
entries: As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can activate this 6-inch wide {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} and deploy it within 15 feet of you. The sphere then captures a holographic recording of the events that occur within a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} centered on it. The cube can record for a total of 5 minutes. You can pause recording, delete a recorded scene, or play back a recorded scene as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action.

The holo-recording can be played back at full-size or at a miniaturized 1-foot scale. However, the presence of magic interferes with the recording process, and high volumes of magic may reduce the playback to an unrecognizable holographic mess.

item.name: Holster
entries: A Holster is a specially-made holder which allows a blaster which lacks {@itemProperty 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed} to be carried on a belt or under the arm.

item.name: Hoverboard
entries: This 3-foot-long metal board produces a low hum and curiously hovers over any surface. You can ride the board or dismount it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. While riding the board, your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases by 10 feet, you ignore {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}, and can move above the surface of liquids without sinking. The board can't scale an incline greater than 45 degrees unless it is in a zero-gravity environment.
You can use your choice of a Dexterity ({@skill Acrobatics|XPHB}) check or a Charisma ({@skill Performance|XPHB}) check to perform tricks on the board.

item.name: Hyper-Krash
entries: This limited-edition can of Krash-branded energy drink was discontinued decades ago for being too extreme (as well as for hazardous side effects from its magical additives). When you drink this potion, a jittery feeling rushes to your extremities. You can take an additional action this turn, which can be used to take only the {@action Attack|XPHB} (one attack only), {@action Dash|XPHB}, {@action Disengage|XPHB}, {@action Hide|XPHB}, or {@action Utilize|XPHB} action. You also have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on all attack rolls and ability checks you make until the end of this turn. The feeling of energy is then replaced by lethargy, and you can't gain the benefits of this potion again for 1 hour.

item.name: Hypodermic Needle
entries: Potions are often loaded into syringes instead of consumed from a bottle. You can load a potion into a Hypodermic Needle as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} and administer it to another creature as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. If the creature is unwilling, it must succeed a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus your Intelligence modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}) to avoid the needle.

item.name: Igniter
entries: An Igniter produces a small flame, which you can use to light a {@item Candle|XPHB}, {@item Torch|XPHB}, or campfire.

item.name: Impulse Unit
entries: You have installed thrusters into your legs and back. Once on each of your turns, when you move at least 15 feet in a straight {@variantrule Line [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Line}, you can move up to 10 additional feet in that direction without spending movement. Alternatively, you can spend 10 feet of movement to jump 10 feet vertically.

item.name: Infrasight Eyes
entries: You have replaced your eyes with sensors that can see in the dark. You gain {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

item.name: Interface Rig
entries: An Interface Rig includes everything necessary to connect to a device without an accessible interface: a {@item Datapad|DarkMatter24} accessor loaded with complicated algorithms, a plethora of wires and connectors, and a heavy magnet in case things get dire. An Interface Rig is often necessary to gain unauthorized access to a system.

item.name: Invisibomb
entries: As a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, you can throw this spherical device up to 30 feet, which detonates in a shimmering 30-foot-radius {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} on impact. Each creature and object that isn't being worn or carried within the {@variantrule Sphere [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Sphere} has the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition until the start of your next turn. The condition ends early immediately for a creature after it makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.

item.name: Jax
entries: Rather than drinking this vial of orange, brackish liquid, you inject into your body as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Once injected, for 1 hour, your Strength and Dexterity scores each increase by 2, to a maximum of 22. You must also succeed on a DC 10 Constitution saving throw or suffer a negative reaction; you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, fall {@condition unconscious}, and can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} for 1 hour.

You can use up to three doses of Jax at once as a part of the same {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Each additional dose you take further increases your Strength and Dexterity scores, up to a maximum of 26. For each dose beyond the first, the Constitution saving throw DC increases by 5, to a maximum of 25.

item.name: Jetpack
entries: This device is a miniature version of the impulse engines used in starships, and has been fitted with straps and a small handheld controller. It has 4 charges and regains {@dice 1d4} expended charges daily at dawn. While wearing it on your back, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and expend 1 charge, gaining a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} for 10 minutes.

item.name: Justiciar's Gavel
entries: This enormous hammer is the badge of office for a dwarven justicar. Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a melee attack roll using this weapon, you can engage its thrusters to deal an extra {@damage 1d4} Bludgeoning damage to the target. This damage is {@dice 1d6} if the target is {@status Bloodied|XPHB}.

entries.name: Upgraded Magic Item
entries: This weapon grows in power as you do. When you reach character level 5, you gain a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. This bonus increases by +1 at level 11 (+2) and level 17 (+3).

item.name: Krash
entries: When you drink this can of sugary liquid as a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, you feel a rush of energy. For the next hour, your {@condition Exhaustion|XPHB} level temporarily decreases by 1, to a minimum of 0. You can only be under the effect of one can of Krash at a time.

item.name: Laser Eyes
entries: One or both of your eyes have been replaced with powerful laser emitters, blasters hidden in your pupils. You are proficient with this weapon and can't be disarmed of it. You can't use this weapon if you have the {@condition Blinded|XPHB} condition.

item.name: Lazarus Unit
entries: You've installed a defibrillator, or a similar piece of technology, into your vital organs. If you are dead or have 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} at the start of your turn, the unit jolts you back to life with a surge of electricity. You revive with 1 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB|Hit Point}. This graft can't revive you if you lack a heart, have died of old age, or are missing vital organs.
Once this graft activates, it can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

item.name: Life Suit
entries: This one-piece jumpsuit comes equipped with a domed glass helmet. While wearing it, you can breathe underwater or in the vacuum of space for up to 24 hours at a time. The suit also protects you from extreme temperatures and pressures (see the Glossary), inhaled poisons and gasses, and contagions. You can wear the suit underneath a suit of armor. To replenish its air supply, the suit must be removed for 2 hours.

item.name: Life Support
entries: Providing a ship with air, heat, and artificial gravity, Life Support is a ship's most essential system. If Life Support is disabled, a temporary backup will be engaged, providing the ship with air and heat for up to 1 hour, but not restoring artificial gravity.
For less conventional starships, such as those shaped as galleons, the Life Support extends a bubble of heat and atmosphere around the entire ship.

An Engineer (or a creature that hacks into the ship computer) can take the Use System action to disable Life Support. Depending on the ship, this may allow them to vent the atmosphere from parts of the ship, disable the artificial gravity (rendering the entire ship a Zero-Gravity environment, if it's in space), or disable the ship's heating and cooling.

item.name: Log Keeper
entries: This foot-long device records and replays audio, organizing entries by date. It can store up to 72 hours of audio before it automatically begins purging the earliest entries.

item.name: Logic Unit
entries: Your brain has been augmented with an algorithmic processing unit. You can add half your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} (round down), to any Intelligence ability check you make that uses a skill proficiency you lack and doesn't already include your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}. Additionally, you know {@language Machine Code|DarkMatter24}, the native code-language of machines. Due to this language, you know the {@spell Technomancy|DarkMatter24} cantrip. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the feat).

item.name: Manipulators
entries: A ship's Manipulators are collapsible devices that allow the ship to interact with ships and objects, sometimes resembling arms, tentacles, or extensions of the hull. An Engineer can take the Use System action to use the Manipulators on a target within 500 feet of the ship. It can transport an object into the ship's cargo hold, clear space debris, open a hatch on a ship, or push a Mega-sized target smaller than the ship up to 1,000 feet away from the ship.

item.name: Marine's Pack
entries: A Marine's Pack includes a {@item Backpack|XPHB}, a {@item Bedroll|XPHB}, {@item Binoculars|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Comm Set|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Concussion Grenade|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Crowbar|XPHB}, a {@item Flashlight|DarkMatter24}, an {@item Igniter|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Life Suit|DarkMatter24}, 10 days of {@item Rations|XPHB}, {@item Rope|XPHB}, a {@item Tactical Vest|DarkMatter24}, and a roll of {@item Vent Tape|DarkMatter24}.

item.name: Motion Tracker
entries: This scanner bears an illuminated screen on one side. While holding it, you can determine the location of any creatures or objects within 60 feet of you that have moved since the end of your last turn, even if they have the {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition or have {@variantrule Cover|XPHB|Total Cover} from you. A creature that has the {@action Hide|XPHB} action's {@condition Invisible|XPHB} condition, however, avoids detection by the tracker.

item.name: Nanobot Canister (Deconstructive)
entries: This capsule contains a swarm of short-lived nanobots designed to destroy, repair, or amass together into a creature. The nanobots come in three varieties: Deconstructive, Reconstructive, and Transformative. All three sets of nanobots are indistinguishable; you can determine the capsule's contents with a DC 15 Intelligence ({@skill Technology|DarkMatter24}) check.

You can take the {@action Magic|XPHB} action to open and throw the canister. Target one creature, object, or unoccupied space within 30 feet of yourself. If the canister is thrown at an unoccupied space, the nanobots cover a 5-foot-square area. The effect is determined by the type of nanobots.

entries.name: Deconstructive Nanobots
entries: The target must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw or be covered with nanobots. At the start of each of its turns, a target covered with the nanobots takes {@damage 1d10} Necrotic damage which ignores {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} and {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB}. After 1 minute, the nanobots deactivate permanently.

item.name: Nanobot Canister (Reconstructive)
entries: This capsule contains a swarm of short-lived nanobots designed to destroy, repair, or amass together into a creature. The nanobots come in three varieties: Deconstructive, Reconstructive, and Transformative. All three sets of nanobots are indistinguishable; you can determine the capsule's contents with a DC 15 Intelligence ({@skill Technology|DarkMatter24}) check.

You can take the {@action Magic|XPHB} action to open and throw the canister. Target one creature, object, or unoccupied space within 30 feet of yourself. If the canister is thrown at an unoccupied space, the nanobots cover a 5-foot-square area. The effect is determined by the type of nanobots.

entries.name: Reconstructive Nanobots
entries: The target is covered in nanobots. At the start of each of its turns, the target regains {@dice 1d6} {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}. After 1 minute, the nanobots deactivate permanently.

item.name: Nanobot Canister (Transformative)
entries: This capsule contains a swarm of short-lived nanobots designed to destroy, repair, or amass together into a creature. The nanobots come in three varieties: Deconstructive, Reconstructive, and Transformative. All three sets of nanobots are indistinguishable; you can determine the capsule's contents with a DC 15 Intelligence ({@skill Technology|DarkMatter24}) check.

You can take the {@action Magic|XPHB} action to open and throw the canister. Target one creature, object, or unoccupied space within 30 feet of yourself. If the canister is thrown at an unoccupied space, the nanobots cover a 5-foot-square area. The effect is determined by the type of nanobots.

entries.name: Transformative Nanobots
entries: The nanobots assemble into a Nanite Swarm at the point of impact. The swarm is friendly to you and your companions, understands your languages, and obeys your spoken commands. If you issue no commands, the swarm takes the {@action Dodge|XPHB} action and moves to avoid danger. After 8 hours, or after the nanite swarm drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, the nanites deactivate.

item.name: Omnitool
entries: This multipurpose gadget contains a plethora of useful tools: small knives of various sizes, a small hammer, screwdrivers, a file, a bottle opener, a small saw, a wrench, a can opener, a wire-cutter, and a small set of pliers.

item.name: Overdrive Module
entries: You have installed an internal generator to temporarily accelerate your reaction speed. You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} to fire up your Overdrive Module. For the next minute, time appears to move in slow motion. When you activate this graft and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on subsequent turns, you gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on the next attack roll or ability check you make before the end of your turn. Additionally, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to gain {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on a Dexterity saving throw or to impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on an attack made against you by a creature you can see.
Once you activate this graft, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

item.name: Personality Module
entries: A Personality Module contains a neural trace of someone's entire personality: their core memories, manner of speaking, likes and dislikes, and even skills. While this module is installed, you are proficient in two skills, know two languages, and have a personality trait inherent to the personality. Each Personality Module offers a different set of skills, languages, and personality traits, according to whom it was modeled after.

item.name: Pilot's Seat
entries: The ship gains the Pilot role.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: If the ship is Personal size or larger, you can install this system twice into a ship. If more than one creature is in the Pilot Crew Role, the two Pilots must take different actions during each round of combat.

item.name: Potion of Liquid Air
entries: When you drink this potion, you can breathe underwater or in the vacuum of space for 8 hours. The potion also protects you from extreme temperatures and pressures.

item.name: Potion of Solar Radiance
entries: When you drink this potion, your body casts {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB} in a 20-foot radius and {@variantrule Dim Light|XPHB} for an additional 20 feet for the next hour. The light is sunlight. Until this duration ends, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB} on your turn to deal {@damage 1d8} Radiant damage to each creature within the {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}. Its liquid is an opaque silver and glows brightly when shaken.

item.name: Probe
entries: A Probe is a remotely-piloted drone deployed from the ship to inspect potentially hazardous targets and environments. The Engineer can take the Use System action to launch, dock, or control the Probe. The Probe has 5 {@variantrule Mega Hit Points|DarkMatter24}, AC 12, a {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} of 1,500 feet, and 360-degree Maneuverability. The Engineer can see and hear through the Probe's sensors and also detect a wide variety of other metrics, such as levels of temperature, gravity, and radiation.

item.name: Psionic Piercing
entries: Made of an exotic crystal, a Psionic Piercing resonates with the underlying psionic fields in the 'Verse and enables its wearer to pull against it. These piercings might be rings, studs, bars, or any other form, and can be worn anywhere on the body.

Attuning to multiple Psionic Piercings counts as attuning to a single magic item, up to a maximum of 7 piercings. For each piercing you are attuned to, you gain one psionic energy point, which you can spend to gain the following properties. You can change which properties you have selected daily at dawn.
If a Psionic Piercing property gives you the ability to cast a spell, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (chosen when you choose the property).

entries.name: Empathy (Costs 1 Point)
entries: You can take the {@action Magic|XPHB} action to probe the mind of a creature you can see within 30 feet of you. You learn the creature's emotional state.

entries.name: Fly (Costs 5 Points)
entries: You have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

entries.name: Influence (Costs 2 Points)
entries: You can cast the {@spell Detect Thoughts|XPHB} and {@spell Suggestion|XPHB} spells once each. Once you cast one of these spells with this property, you can't cast that spell with it again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Minor Kinesis (Costs 1 Point)
entries: You learn the {@spell Mage Hand|XPHB} cantrip, and the hand is {@condition invisible} when you cast the cantrip with this trait. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for this spell when you cast them with this property (choose when you attune to this item).

entries.name: Prescience (Costs 2 Points)
entries: You can glimpse the future as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. The GM reveals something that will likely occur within the next minute. You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on {@variantrule D20 Test|XPHB|D20 Tests} that pertain to the event you glimpsed. You can use this property a number of times equal to the number of Psionic Piercings to which you are attuned and regain all expended uses daily at dawn.

entries.name: Psiblast (Costs 5 Points)
entries: You emit a burst of psionic energy in a 60-foot {@variantrule Cone [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Cone}. Each creature in that area must make an Intelligence saving throw. The DC equals 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus} + your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (your choice). On a failed save, a creature takes {@damage 6d8} Psychic damage and has the {@condition Stunned|XPHB} condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage only. A creature {@condition Stunned|XPHB} by this effect makes another Intelligence saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Psychic Resistance (Costs 1 Point)
entries: You have resistance to Psychic damage.

entries.name: Telepathy (Costs 1 Point)
entries: You can speak telepathically to any creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. Your telepathic utterances are in a language you know, and the creature understands you only if it knows that language. Your communication doesn't give the creature the ability to respond to you telepathically.

entries.name: Telekinesis (Costs 3 Points)
entries: You can cast {@spell Telekinesis|XPHB} once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast it in this way daily at dawn.

entries.name: Third Eye (Costs 3 Points)
entries: You have {@sense Blindsight|XPHB} with a range of 20 feet.

item.name: Quadcorder
entries: This handheld scanning device has four prominent sensors (each looking like a small radar dish) on its operating end. When directed at an object within 5 feet as a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action, the device measures and displays many of that object's intrinsic properties, including its temperature, density, boiling point, freezing point, conductivity, and viscosity.

item.name: Rebounding Blade
entries: You gain a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. It has the {@itemProperty T|XPHB|Thrown} (range 40/120) property. Immediately after any thrown attack, the weapon flies back to your hand.

item.name: Remote Eye
entries: You have replaced one of your eyes with a spherical mechanical replacement, which you can remove or insert as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. Even while the eye is removed, you can see whatever it sees as long as you are within 120 feet of it. The eye can look in every direction, but it can't move on its own.

item.name: Remote Piloting Apparatus
entries: This interconnected array of devices can be installed in a Fighter-sized ship with 1 hour of work. Once the apparatus is installed, the fighter can be deployed and piloted remotely from a controller unit included with the apparatus.
