The controller relays visual and sensor information from the fighter and allows a character using it to enter the Dogfighter ship role. If the ship strays more than 10 miles from the controller, it loses connection and falls dormant until the controller unit is within signal range.

item.name: Replacement
entries: One or more of your organs or limbs has been interchanged with an efficient mechanical version. A Replacement can replace an amputated limb or missing organ but can't revive a creature that has died. Replacement limbs can look like the original limb, or can appear metallic or mechanical. A Replacement organ or limb takes up one body slot relevant to it; for example, a robotic hand takes the Arms slot and a replacement kidney takes up the Internal slot. You can have more than one Replacement in a single body slot.

item.name: Researcher's Pack
entries: A Researcher's Pack includes a {@item Backpack|XPHB}, {@item Binoculars|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Comm Set|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Datapad|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Flashlight|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Holo-Sphere|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Hypodermic Needle|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Life Suit|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Log Keeper|DarkMatter24}, an {@item Omnitool|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Quadcorder|DarkMatter24}, and a {@item Wristwatch|DarkMatter24}.

item.name: Resistance Plating
entries: This subdermal graft redirects a specific type of elemental energy. You have {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB} to one type of damage while this graft is installed. The GM chooses the type or determines it randomly from the options below.

item.name: Ring of Paradoxes
entries: While wearing this ring, you can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to expend 1 of its 3 charges to cast the spell {@spell Paradox|DarkMatter24} from it. The ring becomes nonmagical when you use the last charge.

item.name: Ring of Spacewalking
entries: While attuned to this ring, you can breathe underwater or in the vacuum of space. The ring also protects you from extreme temperatures and pressures (see the Glossary). Additionally, in zero-gravity environments, you gain a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

item.name: Roach
entries: Ocoulori Radavitis (called a Roach by many spacers) is an insectlike creature that is consumed to improve the results of a void jump.

Consuming the ten-legged insectoid known as a Roach creates a wave of euphoria that allows one to see the entire universe at once and perform accurate void jumps. However, long-term roach consumption can be addictive and psychologically harmful.

item.name: Scout Scanner
entries: This device, worn over one eye, has 3 charges and regains all expended charges daily at dawn. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}, you can press a button on the device and expend 1 charge to analyze a creature you can see within 60 feet. You learn two of the following pieces of information: the target's {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB}, current {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, its {@variantrule Immunity|XPHB|Immunities}, its {@variantrule Resistance|XPHB|Resistances}, its {@variantrule Vulnerability|XPHB|Vulnerabilities}, or  any spells that currently affect the target.

item.name: Sensors
entries: A ship's Sensors allow it to perceive ships and obstacles and communicate with other ships out to a range of 1,000 miles. Communications between ships can include audio, video, and holographic transmissions. If Sensors are disabled, the ship has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls.

entries.name: Deep Scan
entries: If the ship has an Engineer, they can take the Use System action to perform a deep scan on an object of interest within 1 mile of the ship. The Engineer makes an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check to examine the target. On a success, the Engineer learns of lifesigns within the target, whether the target has functional power, and other details of the GM's choice.

entries.name: Planetary Scan
entries: If the ship has an Engineer, they can take the Use System action to perform a scan of a planet within 1,000 miles of the ship. The Engineer makes an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|XPHB}) check. On a success, you learn if the planet has major environmental hazards, if the planet's surface is inhabited, and other details of the GM's choice.

item.name: Shield Emitter
entries: This device emits a shimmering field of magical force around you, protecting you from a single blow. You can activate this device as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. The next attack made against you within the next hour has a -10 penalty to hit. Then, the emitter must recharge and can't be used again until the next dawn.

item.name: Shield Generator
entries: The Shield Generator projects a directional shield around the ship. By default, the shield is forward-facing, and it can be repositioned by the ship's Engineer as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}. If the Shield Generator is disabled, the ship loses all of its Shield Points until it is repaired.
The number of Shield Points provided by a Shield Generator depend on a ship's size, as detailed on the Shield Points table.

item.name: Shield Module
entries: You can cast the {@spell Shield|XPHB} spell once using this graft without a spell slot. Once you activate this graft, you can't do so again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}.

item.name: Shipmending Spray
entries: This canister of pressurized nanites rapidly repairs damage to ships. The canister weighs 20 pounds and can be used as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action from within or outside a damaged ship. The ship regains {@dice 3d6} {@variantrule Mega Hit Points|DarkMatter24}.

item.name: Shipmending Sprays
entries: This canister of pressurized nanites rapidly repairs damage to ships. The canister weighs 20 pounds and can be used as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action from within or outside a damaged ship. The rarity and number of {@variantrule Mega Hit Points|DarkMatter24} the ship regains vary, as shown on the Shipmending Spray table.

item.name: Shock Absorbers
entries: Shock-absorbing coils in your legs let you bound higher and cushion your landings. The distance of your {@variantrule Long Jump|XPHB|Long} and {@variantrule High Jump|XPHB|High} Jumps increases by 10 feet (this extra distance costs movement as normal). You suffer no penalty for making a standing {@variantrule High Jump|XPHB|High} or {@variantrule Long Jump|XPHB|Long} Jump.
You can take a {@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} when you fall to reduce any damage you take from the fall by an amount equal to five times your {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}.

item.name: Shoulder Cannon
entries: This apparatus is worn on the back and produces a shoulder-mounted cannon above your left shoulder when you speak the command word as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action. Once activated, the cannon makes an attack at the start of each of your turns (no action required) against the nearest enemy it can see within 60 feet of you. The cannon has a +9 attack bonus and deals {@damage 3d8} Force damage on a hit. The cannon has {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} and {@sense Thermalsight|DarkMatter24} with a range of 120 feet, and can see {@condition Invisible|XPHB} creatures.

The cannon remains active for 1 minute. If you are {@condition Incapacitated|XPHB} or die, the cannon remains active until the end of its duration. Once activated, the cannon can't be activated again until the next dawn.

item.name: Signal Jammer
entries: The Engineer can take a Use System action to activate a Signal Jammer, attempting to disrupt the Sensors of a ship within 3,000 feet, which makes a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 plus the Engineer's Intelligence modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). On a failed save, the target ship's Sensors are disabled until the start of the Engineer's next turn; the ship has {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on attack rolls for the duration.

item.name: Singularity Emitter
entries: This stripped-down Dark Matter engine has been retrofitted to launch miniature black holes with the pull of a trigger. This device has 5 charges and regains {@dice 1d4 + 1} expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, you can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action and expend 1 or more of its charges to cast the {@spell Gravity Well|ValdaSpire24} spell (save DC 15) from it. For 1 charge, you cast the 3rd-level version of the spell. You can increase the spell slot level by one for each additional charge you expend.

item.name: Skeleton Keycard
entries: This black keycard, emblazoned with a white skull, is imbued with magic that can unlock any door. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can use this keycard on any door which could be hacked, such as those on a ship, even if such a door doesn't have a keycard reader. The door becomes unlocked, as if targeted by the {@spell Knock|XPHB} spell, and opens.

item.name: Sling
entries: A Sling is a strap which attaches to a weapon (usually a blaster) and is worn on the body. When you drop a weapon attached to a sling you are wearing, it falls to your side and continues to hang within reach.

item.name: Solar Wings of Ra
entries: While wearing this cloak in an area of {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}, you can take a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to speak its command word. This transforms the cloak into a pair of radiant wings on your back until you dismiss them (no action required). The wings give you a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} of 60 feet. If you are no longer in {@variantrule Bright Light|XPHB}, you lose this {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB}.

entries.name: Magic Item Set
entries: Attuning to these wings and an {@item Ankh of Ra|DarkMatter24} and a {@item Heretical Sunstaff of Ra|DarkMatter24} counts as being attuned to a single item. If you are attuned to the wings and one of these items, you can use the wings to cast the spell {@spell Daylight|XPHB} at will without using a spell slot.

item.name: Sorting Beast
entries: The Sorting Beast is a six-legged machine with eyes, legs, and antennae at both ends, as well as an array of measuring devices near its center. It can manipulate and hold objects up to 30 pounds in weight. When activated as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, the Sorting Beast sets about collecting and sorting all loose valuable items within 100 feet. It sorts all Gold Pieces, Silver Pieces, and Copper Pieces into neat stacks of 10. For material goods, such as precious stones, the machine can appraise value by weight and quality before sorting the goods appropriately and printing the results on a fine paper strip. The machine continues sorting until finished or deactivated (no action required). Additionally, the Sorting Beast can cast the spell {@spell Identify|XPHB}, without using material components, on an object you designate. Once it casts {@spell Identify|XPHB}, it can't do so again until the next dawn.

item.name: Spacer's Pack
entries: A Spacer's Pack includes a {@item Backpack|XPHB}, a {@item Bandolier|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Comm Set|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Datapad|DarkMatter24}, 2 {@item Flashlight|DarkMatter24|Flashlights}, a {@item Holo-Sphere|DarkMatter24}, an {@item Interface Rig|DarkMatter24}, 2 cans of {@item Krash|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Life Suit|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Log Keeper|DarkMatter24}, an {@item Igniter|DarkMatter24}, an {@item Omnitool|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Quadcorder|DarkMatter24}, 10 rolls of {@item Vent Tape|DarkMatter24}, and a {@item Wristwatch|DarkMatter24}.

item.name: Spacewalkers
entries: This graft creates a zone of breathable air, allowing you to breathe underwater or the vacuum of space. The graft also protects you from extreme temperatures and pressures. Additionally, in zero-gravity environments, you have a {@variantrule Fly Speed|XPHB} equal to your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB}.

item.name: Spider Pod
entries: When you throw this oblong metal container as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, it unfolds into a {@creature Mechanical Spider|DarkMatter24} (see Monsters chapter for statistics). Your spider acts independently of you, but it always obeys your commands. In combat, it takes its turn immediately before or after your turn each round (your choice). If the spider drops to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB}, it can't be repaired. You can collapse the spider back down into its pod as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action. You can only have 3 spiders under your control at any time.

item.name: Spiked Skin
entries: This mechanical skin conceals thousands of razor sharp spikes, which you can extend at a moment's notice. When a creature you can see within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you can use your
{@variantrule Reaction|XPHB} to deal {@damage 1d4} Piercing damage to that creature. The damage increases by {@dice 1d4} when you reach level 5 ({@dice 2d4}), 11 ({@dice 3d4}), and 17 ({@dice 4d4}).

item.name: Superior Shipmending Spray
entries: This canister of pressurized nanites rapidly repairs damage to ships. The canister weighs 20 pounds and can be used as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action from within or outside a damaged ship. The ship regains {@dice 12d6} {@variantrule Mega Hit Points|DarkMatter24}.

item.name: Supreme Shipmending Spray
entries: This canister of pressurized nanites rapidly repairs damage to ships. The canister weighs 20 pounds and can be used as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action from within or outside a damaged ship. The ship regains {@dice 18d6} {@variantrule Mega Hit Points|DarkMatter24}.

item.name: Surveyor's Pack
entries: A Surveyor's Pack includes a {@item Backpack|XPHB}, a {@item Bandolier|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Bedroll|XPHB}, {@item Binoculars|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Comm Set|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Flashlight|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Log Keeper|DarkMatter24}, an {@item Igniter|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Life Suit|DarkMatter24}, a {@item Quadcorder|DarkMatter24}, 10 days of {@item Rations|XPHB}, {@item Rope|XPHB}, and a {@item Wristwatch|DarkMatter24}.

item.name: Tachyon Missile Launcher
entries: This shoulder-mounted cannon fires heat-seeking missiles designed to penetrate a ship's hull. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you can lock onto a ship or Mega-sized creature you can see within 2,000 feet. The launcher loses its lock on a target if the target moves more than 2,000 feet away from you or takes Evasive Maneuvers. Once locked onto a target, you can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action on a subsequent turn to fire the missile. Make a ranged spell attack with a +9 bonus. On a hit, the target takes {@dice 3d10} Mega Necrotic damage.

item.name: Tactical Vest
entries: This light vest is covered in pouches, straps, and holsters. The vest can carry a Melee weapon with the {@itemProperty 2H|XPHB|Two-Handed} or {@itemProperty V|XPHB|Versatile} property on its back and a {@item Dagger|XPHB} or an {@item Antimatter Dagger|Darkmatter24} on its front. It has two {@item Holster|DarkMatter24|Holsters} and one built-in {@item Sling|DarkMatter24}. The Tactical Vest can be worn atop armor.

item.name: Teleporters
entries: The Teleporters power a set of permanent {@spell Teleportation Circle|XPHB|Teleportation Circles} designed for short-range transportation. The Engineer can take the Use System action to activate the Teleporters, targeting an unmoving location within 100 miles of the ship, creating a temporary destination circle at that location. This circle lasts for 1 minute or until another destination circle is created.

Because the resonance of a Dark Matter engine interferes with the teleportation magic, you can't create a destination circle inside a ship with a functioning Dark Matter engine unless both ships coordinate to allow transit.

entries.name: Repeatable
entries: You can install this system twice into a ship of Frigate size or larger. The second set of {@spell Teleportation Circle|XPHB|Teleportation Circles} is constantly active and facilitates quick transportation around the ship.

item.name: Terraforming Engine
entries: This extraordinary machine, standing 40 feet tall and bearing great smokestacks, can transmute materials and balance a planet's atmosphere to support life. The engine can be activated or deactivated with 1 hour of work. If set down on a Tier 4 or higher planet, activated, and allowed to process the planet's water, atmosphere, and soil for a year, the engine lowers the planet's Tier by 1. The engine has no effect on a Tier 1 or Tier X world, and two terraforming engines can't lower a planet's Tier by more than 1 (though multiple engines might provide redundancy, should one fail). If the engine is deactivated or removed from the planet, the planet degrades to its original condition over the course of 7 days.

item.name: Thermalsight Eyes
entries: You have augmented your eyes with sensors that detect heat. You gain {@sense Thermalsight|DarkMatter24} with a range of 30 feet.

item.name: Thunder Rifle
entries: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When the weapon hits a target, it produces an explosion in a 5-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from the target. The weapon can target an unoccupied space within its range. Each creature within {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} must make a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking half the Thunder damage rolled on a failed save, or no damage on a successful one.

item.name: Titan Armor
entries: You have plating installed into your body, resembling a suit of armor. Your base {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} equals 17 (your Dexterity modifier doesn't affect this number). You can wear armor on top of your Titan Armor, and you can use either armor to determine your AC. You can use a {@item Shield|XPHB} and still gain this benefit.

item.name: Traction Spikes
entries: Retractable spikes in your legs allow you to ignore {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|XPHB}. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws you make to avoid the {@condition Prone|XPHB} condition.

item.name: Tractor Beam
entries: A Tractor Beam is a device designed to pull spacecraft and other objects toward the ship. An Engineer can take the Use System action to target a Mega-sized ship, object, or creature within 3,000 feet. A Mega creature or ship makes a Dexterity saving throw (DC 8 plus the Engineer's Strength or Intelligence modifier and {@variantrule Proficiency|XPHB|Proficiency Bonus}). A creature or ship larger than your ship automatically succeeds on this save.

On a failed save, the target is caught in the Tractor Beam and is pulled up to 1,000 feet closer to the ship. The target's {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} is 0. At the start of each of the Engineer's turns, it can take a {@action Utilize|XPHB} action to pull the target up to 1,000 feet closer to the ship.
The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, escaping the Tractor Beam on a success.

item.name: Un's Codex
entries: This 6-inch wide mechanical disc consists of innumerable layers of technological ephemera. At first blush, it could be a spare starship component, albeit a strange one. However, rotating one of its layers causes other layers to rotate, counter-rotate, or become locked. The disc itself is an intricate puzzle. Solving it unlocks the doors of the universe.

The disc, Un's Codex, is composed of exotic metals of the very same type that can be found on Maw stations and within the heart of the Sepulcher Star. Like all other antediluvian relics of such make, its creation is attributed to Old Un, but its true history is lost to time.

entries.name: Solving the Codex
entries: Until the Codex is solved, you don't gain any of its benefits by attuning to it. You can spend 8 hours while attuned to the Codex to solve part of its puzzle, unlocking one of the Codex's properties of your choice. These unlocked properties extend only to you; another creature that attunes to the Codex must unlock its properties to gain their benefits.

entries.name: Blink Step
entries: You can cast the spell {@spell Misty Step|XPHB} without a spell slot. When you cast this spell using the Codex, you can teleport to a space occupied by a creature, which makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes {@damage 4d6} Force damage and is pushed to the nearest unoccupied space. On a success, the creature takes half as much damage and you instead move to the nearest unoccupied space.

entries.name: Extradimensional Lodge
entries: You and up to six willing creatures within 30 feet of you that you choose are transported to a demiplane containing a rustic yet stately lodge. The lodge appears to be within a scenic, coniferous forest, but leaving the lodge teleports you back to the location from which you entered. The lodge has several floors and comfortable accommodations for dozens of individuals. It would seem that previous owners of the Codex have taken up residence here, for nonmagical weapons and equipment are stashed in a few of the rooms. Moreover, the lodge contains numerous hidden compartments and secret passages.

The lodge is attended by dozens of near-transparent servants that obey all who enter. Each servant can perform any task a normal human servant could perform, but they can't attack or take any action that would directly harm another creature. Thus, the servants can fetch things, clean, mend, fold clothes, light fires, serve food, pour wine, and so on. The servants can go anywhere in the lodge but can't leave it.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Slip Gate
entries: The Codex has 4 charges and regains 1 charge daily at dawn. As a {@action Magic|XPHB} action, you create two 10-foot diameter circular portals at locations you choose on the same plane of existence. These locations must be known to you, or you can specify a general location, such as a particular Maw.

The portals are two-dimensional glowing rings filled with mist that blocks sight. They float inches from the ground and are perpendicular to it. Anything that travels through the front of one portal is instantly transported to the other location, appearing in the unoccupied space nearest to the front of the portal. The portals dissipate after 1 minute, or if you dismiss them on your turn (no action required).

entries.name: Universal Function
entries: You can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action using the Codex to overwrite a fundamental law of the universe in a 15-foot {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation} originating from you. You can use this ability to increase or decrease gravity in the area, to change the boiling or melting point of a particular material within the area, to increase or decrease the flow of time in the area (as per the {@spell Haste|XPHB} or {@spell Slow|XPHB} spell for all creatures within the {@variantrule Emanation [Area of Effect]|XPHB|Emanation}), to make the region breathable (as per Zone of Atmosphere), or to change another fundamental law of your choice, at the GM's discretion. If you attempt to change something that is too fundamental (such as attempting to reverse the flow of time in the area), the Codex does nothing and your action is wasted. This change lasts for 1 minute or until you use this ability again.

entries.name: Destroying the Codex
entries: Though the Codex seems to be fragile, its exotic composition makes it impervious to damage. The artifact can only be destroyed by Old Un itself, but casting it into the Sepulcher Star or any black hole will be sufficient to banish it for {@dice 1d100} years, after which time it will reappear somewhere in the 'Verse.

item.name: Universal Translator
entries: This handheld device, a necessity for distant voyages, translates any spoken language. While holding it, you can understand any spoken language you hear. Moreover, when you communicate by speaking or signing, any creature that knows at least one language and can hear the speech or see the signing can understand you.

item.name: Vent Tape
entries: This durable, adhesive tape is useful for any application that involves sticking two things together. While more creative minds might use large quantities of Vent Tape for other uses, most people use it for quick repairs and affixed {@item Flashlight|DarkMatter24|Flashlights} to blasters in a pinch. A single roll of Vent Tape contains 60 feet of 2-inch wide tape.

item.name: Voice Changer
entries: Your vocal cords have been replaced with an electronic modulator, allowing you to change the pitch, tone, and characteristics of your voice at will. You can unerringly mimic any voice or sound you have heard, and you can augment your voice with synthetic effects, such as reverb.

item.name: Void Beacon
entries: This beacon transmits an ultra-high frequency signal through the Void, allowing it to be detected tens of thousands of light-years away. This signal consists of the beacon's current coordinates and a short message of up to 16 characters (spaces count as characters). This message can manually be changed as a {@action Magic|XPHB} action. Once activated, the beacon repeatedly transmits its signal for 7 days and then burns out permanently.

item.name: W-REC
entries: You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon, which is fitted with dozens of absurd and unnecessary modifications. This weapon gains the {@itemMastery Automatic|DarkMatter24} mastery property in addition to the {@itemMastery Mounted|DarkMatter24} property. If you have proficiency with this weapon, you can use both of its mastery properties, even if you don't have the Weapon Mastery feature, and it doesn't count against the number of weapons you can use.

Once on each of your turns, if you attack with this weapon against a target and hit two or more times, you can make another attack against the same target. This attack is always made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB}, regardless of circumstance. If this attack hits, you can make another attack against the same target, attacking again if you hit, and so on, until you make a total of five attacks against the target or miss.

item.name: Weapon Wheel
entries: This device, a bracer with an affixed rotary dial and several buttons lining its circumference, is connected to nine small extradimensional spaces. While wearing this bracer, you can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to deposit any weapon or object you are holding that weighs no more than 100 pounds and can fit into a 10-foot cube into one of the extradimensional spaces, linking that item to the wheel. The wheel can be linked to up to 9 items at a time, one in each extradimensional space. You can use a {@action Magic|XPHB} action to unlink an item from the wheel.

Once on each of your turns (no action required), you can teleport one of the wheel's linked items to your hand. Doing so also causes any other items linked to the wheel to return their extradimensional spaces.

item.name: Wristwatch
entries: A simple device with a simple purpose, this watch reports the time in a way that is consistent with all major galactic factions.

item.name: Zipgun
entries: This blaster is designed to be fired only once, but at far above nominal power. On a hit, this weapon deals {@damage 6d6} Necrotic damage. After it is fired, the blaster smolders, ceases to be magical, and becomes unusable.
